chapter_title: [C]oncerning the Father of Gr[eat]ness: [ho]w he is established and determined.
chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly core cosmological-correspondential exposition: an impersonal, systematic description of the Father of Greatness established in five light limbs (with sensory/emanational qualities) and twelve light limbs/wisdoms, all kept entirely within the cosmic system (aeons, storehouses, limbs). Only the opening dialogue-attribution is later frame.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic dialogue frame: "Once again the apostle speaks to his disciples" + exhortative prompt to listen. This is compilation/hagiographic apparatus, not substrate teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: Very great is [land of] light in the presence of they who will hear and know it, due to the first Father of Greatness. How he ex[ists and is] established in his five light limbs, which are [ ... the store]houses that have neither limit nor measure to the[m ... ] mind, thought, insight, counsel and [consideration ... ] his twelve light limbs that are his twelve wisdoms.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic cosmological structure (five limbs/storehouses; twelve limbs/wisdoms) in impersonal expository voice; no institutional or citation vector.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, there are five great light lim[bs] in each one [ ... ] five grea[t] springs of praise gush for[th ... ] five great [ ... ] lig[ht ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumerative degree-structure language (five-fold repetition; internal cosmic imagery like springs of praise). Fits substrate mapping style.

paragraphs.core_text: The first is his light that enlig[htens ... ] it gushed forth from him and pour[ed ... ] a[l]] aeons.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First limb defined by function/emanation (light that enlightens; gushing/pouring into aeons). Cosmos→cosmos mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: The second is the perfume of the [ ... ] and pervades all the aeons of greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second limb given as sensory correspondence (perfume) with cosmic pervasion across aeons; classic substrate register.

paragraphs.core_text: The third is his living voice of [ ... ... ] all his aeons [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third limb as "living voice" operating within aeons—impersonal mechanism, no address/polemic.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth is his [ ... ]-ness [ ... ] gushes forth from him [ ... o]ut [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Though lacunose, it continues the five-limb enumeration with the same emanational mechanics (gushes forth), indicating the same core sequence.

paragraphs.core_text: The fif[th] is his great glorio[us ... ] that [ ... , w]hich [has been ma]nifested all the tim[e], whi[ch contin]ues [ ... ] all of them. It was sculpted in them [ ... ] sealed in the [m ... ] sealed [ ... ] as they send [ ... ] in [ ... ... ] they too receive nourishment [ ... ] immediately [ ... his] living voi[ce ... ] joy [ ... ] set up anew. It shall gush forth from it [ ... ] they shall [ ... ] and become rich in the [ ... ] too is beautiful [ ... ] portray[al ... ] adornment [ ... ] and they live [ ... ... ] for ev[e]r.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continuation of the fifth-limb description using internal-cosmic processes (manifestation, sealing, nourishment, living voice, joy, renewal) without shifting to institutional application or NT citation; remains within the same substrate enumeration.
